requirements: Our small gym wants a tool to manage class bookings. Members should be able to see the weekly class schedule, book a spot, and cancel up to 2 hours before the class starts. Each class has a capacity limit; when it's full, people join a waitlist and get promoted automatically if someone cancels. Staff need a simple way to add or remove classes. We don't want members double-booking themselves into overlapping classes. Data should survive a restart.

human_feedback: The waitlist promotion doesn't re-check for overlapping bookings before adding a promoted member. Fix promote() to run the same overlap check as a normal booking, and add a unit test covering it.
